title: Accessibility feature IFEO debugger hijack
description: Detects a Debugger value set under an Image File Execution Options key for a Windows accessibility or logon helper executable.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may configure an Image File Execution Options debugger for a Windows accessibility executable to obtain persistence or privileged execution from the logon screen.
hypothesis.rationale: MITRE documents accessibility-feature backdoors and explicitly recommends monitoring IFEO debugger modifications, while SigmaHQ maintains a critical registry analytic for the same mechanism; legitimate debugging of these binaries is uncommon.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify Debugger values written to bounded IFEO keys for selected accessibility or logon helper executables while leaving unrelated IFEO targets, other value names and non-IFEO registry paths unmatched.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint registry events

triage.summary: Inspect the debugger payload, modifying process and endpoint context immediately; this mechanism is high-confidence but still requires confirmation before containment.
steps: Review the complete registry key, debugger value, initiating process, command line, account and endpoint role.
Inspect the configured debugger binary, signer, creation source and executions from the logon screen or accessibility shortcut.
Confirm a documented debugging or accessibility-support change; remove unauthorized values, isolate the endpoint and investigate privileged follow-on activity.
false_positives: Rare approved debugging or accessibility-support workflows that intentionally configure IFEO Debugger values for the selected Windows executables

validation.expected_outcome: Match Debugger values set under selected accessibility IFEO keys; do not match unrelated executables, other value names, other paths or incomplete events.
